notes: renderer=skia-software; unthrottled_redraw=true; frame_ms = interval between consecutive frame ends; frame end = first winit about_to_wait after a RedrawRequested (Slint renders and presents synchronously while handling RedrawRequested: softbuffer present_with_damage for software/skia-software, eglSwapBuffers for femtovg), observed through the public slint::winit_030::CustomApplicationHandler; set_rendering_notifier is not usable as frame end (AfterRendering fires before present, and the software renderer returns Unsupported). continuous redraw requested from about_to_wait via WinitWindowAccessor::with_winit_window(|w| w.request_redraw()), which bypasses Slint's internal X11 TimerBasedFrameThrottle (60 Hz timer) using public documented APIs only (feature unstable-winit-030) ; 2 s warm-up not recorded. canvas = one Slint Rectangle element per shape (no immediate-mode canvas API in Slint; repeater over VecModel, all rows set_row_data each frame), @linear-gradient background, drop-shadow-* on 1/10; graph = Path element, commands string rebuilt each frame (10000 pts); all primitives rendered by this renderer
version: slint 1.18.1 (backend winit 0.30.13 x11, renderer skia-software via skia-safe/skia-bindings 0.153.3, softbuffer 0.4.8); rustc 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c3 2026-10-13); image 0.25.10
